body: Tried a different charger and outlet, still nothing. Even the charging light doesn't come on.
Thanks for reporting this. Can you confirm which version of Outlook you're running and whether the calendar is syncing too, or just email?
It's the Microsoft 365 version. Calendar is syncing fine, it's only new emails that aren't coming through.
Got it, that narrows it down. Looking into the mailbox sync settings now, will update you shortly.
Could you try swapping the HDMI cable for a spare if you have one? Want to rule out a cable fault first.
Don't have a spare on hand, but I tried a different HDMI port on the laptop and it's still flickering.
Understood, sounds like the cable then. I'll drop a new HDMI cable at your desk this morning.
New cable fixed it, no more flickering. Thanks for the quick turnaround!
Can you send a screenshot of the exact error message you're seeing when the VPN times out?
It just says 'Connection timed out, please check your network settings' and then disconnects after about 30 seconds.
Found it, your VPN profile had a corrupted certificate. Reissued it and reinstalled the client remotely, please try connecting again.
That worked, connected on the first try. Appreciate the quick fix.
Great, glad it's sorted. Closing this ticket out now.
Happy to help with this. Could you let me know the purpose of the NOC so I include the right wording?
It's for a visa application, they just need confirmation of my current role and salary.
Noted, I'm preparing it now and it should be ready for you within two business days.
Sorry to hear about the emergency, your leave is approved effective immediately. Let us know if you need anything else.
Thank you so much for the quick approval, really appreciate it.
Sure thing, could you confirm the bank name and whether you need it addressed to them directly?
It's for Emirates NBD, yes please address it directly to the bank.
Certificate has been issued and emailed to you and the bank directly.
